metric_definitions.oracle_specific_conflict_scr_pct: Conflict rows only, both replicas scored against base + generated deltas; LWW is not semantically equivalent to this additive oracle.
metric_definitions.benchmark_row_value_agreement_pct: Agreement over ordered bench_rows.value vectors only; not full-database convergence.
metric_definitions.application_sum_baseline: Same scalar additive rule implemented with direct SQLite writes; omits engine operation identity, receipts, conflict persistence, quarantine, and checkpoint guarantees.
metric_definitions.batch_sync_ms: Wall time around engine sync_replicas or the direct-SQL application merge; initialization and local writes excluded.

configuration.workload_mode: sequential local writes followed by one batch merge/sync
